title: Phillips quartet album leads to the big band album
summary: A successful quartet album for Philips let Herman persuade the label to record the big band, producing Encore in 1963.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And then, of course, I think another thing that made it all possible was, in the midst of this whole scene, I went in with the rhythm section and did a quartet album for Phillips.

And it was the first successful album we'd had in several years, as far as sales went and so on, and it played. And from that, I was able to convince them, because we were now in the Metropole, that they should record a big band. They had no eyes to, just -- most labels didn't at that period.
But they went ahead with it, and that was one of the earliest things in '63, and "Encore" of '63.
